I replied to Pree in a thread on her #central-team message to confirm I've noted that Tansley Parcel's signed order form is due 25 August. Nothing I found says otherwise, though there's no Tansley Parcel account folder I can see.

One thing doesn't add up: today is 14 October 2026, so 25 August this year has already passed. In the same reply I asked her to confirm whether she means next year or whether the date has moved. I'll update it if she does.
